question: Which Chola ruler is credited with the extensive overseas expedition to Southeast Asia, particularly against the Srivijaya Empire?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rajendra I**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rajendra I**, also known as **Rajendra Chola I**, was one of the greatest rulers of the Chola dynasty in South India.
 
• He is especially renowned for his **overseas expeditions** to Southeast Asia, particularly against the **Srivijaya Empire** in the early 11th century.
